name: NeMo Guardrails
summary: NeMo Guardrails is NVIDIA's open-source Python toolkit for adding programmable rails around an LLM app. Rails can check or rewrite input, output, retrieved chunks and tool calls, and dialogue flows are written in the Colang language.
goodFor: Self-hosted, configurable rails in Python apps
Combining several checks (topic, safety, PII, jailbreak) in one pipeline
watchOut: Pre-1.0 with breaking changes between releases
Colang is another language to learn
